prompt_text: Who is the best roofer in Denver for hail damage repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a reliable way to name one roofer as *the* best, but **Gates Roofing** looks like a strong first call for Denver hail damage: its Denver page reports a 4.9/5 rating from 348+ reviews and focuses on hail claims. [Gates Roofing](https://www.gatesroof.com/areas/denver) · (720) 766-3377

I’d also get a comparison quote from **Woodberg Roofing & Restoration**, which has BBB-listed customer reviews describing hail-damage assessments and repairs. [Woodberg on BBB](https://www.bbb.org/us/co/denver/profile/roofing-contractors/woodberg-roofing-and-restoration-llc-1296-90245804)

Before signing, verify the contractor’s local license and insurance, ask for a written scope and workmanship warranty, and get at least two inspections. Don’t sign over insurance benefits or let a contractor pressure you to file a claim; your insurer decides what damage is covered.
